title: Quick Crunchy Turkish Green Bean Pilaf
description: A flavorful and crunchy Turkish dish featuring green beans and a pasta water emulsion, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This herbal and monsoon-inspired dish is friendly for all, including those who follow Buddhist temple dietary guidelines.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the green beans to the skillet and cook until they are tender but still crisp, about 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the salt, black pepper, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the green beans and spice mixture.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed and the mixture is heated through.
Transfer the pilaf to a hot stone plate and serve immediately.
